Depth.description_en: The category level. The root category is 1

OwnerIds.description_en:
The user IDs of the owners. Multiple user IDs are separated by commas. You can obtain the UserId value by calling the [GetUser]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147098.html） or [ListUsers]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html） operation.
The parameter name for the user ID is UserId
